description: Sample MYMP.org.my import data for MP biographies

notes.source: Data manually collected from https://mymp.org.my (volunteer project)
ethical_guidelines: Do NOT scrape MYMP automatically - respect their terms of service
Always credit MYMP as the source of biography data
Link back to original MYMP profile page
No commercial resale of this data
Update manually and periodically, not in real-time

data_format.parliamentCode: Official parliament code (e.g., P001) - preferred for matching
data_format.name: Full name as registered - used with constituency for matching
data_format.constituency: Constituency name - used with name for matching
data_format.mympSlug: URL slug from MYMP (e.g., 'syed-saddiq' from https://mymp.org.my/p/syed-saddiq)
data_format.politicalHistory: Array of party affiliations with years

mps.name: Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman
mps.bioSummary: YB Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman is the founder and President of MUDA (Malaysian United Democratic Alliance) and former Minister of Youth and Sports. He is known for being the youngest Cabinet Minister in Malaysian history when appointed in 2018 at age 25.
education: Bachelor of Arts in International and Global Studies, University of Western Australia
careerHistory: World-class debater (Best Speaker, World Universities Debating Championship 2015)
Political Secretary to former PM Mahathir Mohamad
nonPoliticalAffiliations: Former President of Malaysian United Democratic Alliance (MUDA)

mps.name: Dato' Sri Mohamed Khaled Nordin
mps.bioSummary: YB Dato' Sri Mohamed Khaled Nordin is a senior UMNO politician and the current Minister of Defence. He has served in various capacities including Minister of Higher Education and Menteri Besar of Johor.
education: Bachelor of Arts (Hons), University of Malaya
Master in Public Administration, University of Southern California

politicalHistory.notes: Current member, former Johor UMNO Chief

mps.name: Rafizi Ramli
mps.bioSummary: YB Rafizi Ramli is a Malaysian politician and economist serving as the Minister of Economy. He is known for his role as a whistleblower in exposing the 1MDB scandal and as Vice President of PKR.
education: Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical), University of Leeds, UK
Master of Business Administration (Finance), University of Leeds, UK

mps.name: Hannah Yeoh
mps.bioSummary: YB Hannah Yeoh Tseow Suan is a Malaysian politician currently serving as Minister of Youth and Sports. She was the first female Speaker of the Selangor State Assembly and is known for her advocacy on women's rights and social issues.
education: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), University of Tasmania
nonPoliticalAffiliations: Advocate for gender equality and children's rights

mps.name: Wong Chen
mps.bioSummary: YB Wong Chen is a Malaysian lawyer and politician from PKR. He is known for his work on constitutional law, human rights, and parliamentary reforms.
education: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), University of London (External)

request_body.overwrite: Set to true to overwrite existing MYMP data, false to skip MPs that already have data
